title: 7 Door Hanger Marketing Secrets to Eye-Popping ROI

facts.fact: Power Direct's standard door hanger size is 5.5 x 17 inches.
facts.quote: Power Direct’s standard size door hanger is much larger — 5.5 x 17 inches — more like mini-billboards.

facts.fact: Many door hanger designers and print services commonly use a 3.5 x 8.5 inch size, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: Look up almost any door hanger designers or print services and you’ll see them using the same size media — 3.5 x 8.5 inch.

facts.fact: Power Direct states it offers hundreds, and in its words thousands, of demographic and other targeting variables for door hanger campaigns.
facts.quote: We offer hundreds — yes, thousands — of demographic and other types of targeting variables

facts.fact: Power Direct claims front door marketing earns nearly 100% of promised impressions, since nearly everyone who finds something on their porch will look at it.
facts.quote: Front door marketing earns nearly 100% of promised impressions, because pretty much everyone who finds something on their porch will look at it.

facts.fact: A sample offer given in the vendor's copy examples is 'Save 20% on your first order'.
A sample offer given in the vendor's copy examples is 'Start your free trial within the next 30 days and get a second month free'.
facts.quote: Start your free trial within the next 30 days and get a second month free

facts.fact: A test campaign for door hanger distribution might use around 20,000 addresses before sending a larger campaign to several hundred thousand more addresses.
facts.quote: you first print a “test” campaign with, say, 20,000 addresses, with future plans to send out a larger campaign to several hundred thousand more.

facts.fact: A test campaign might run 2-4 different versions of a door hanger advertising message.
facts.quote: The test campaign might run 2-4 different versions of your door hanger advertising message.

facts.fact: The page states that distribution can be accomplished in a few days for smaller campaigns and sometimes over weeks for larger ones.
facts.quote: Distribution can be accomplished in a few days for smaller campaigns, and sometimes over weeks for larger ones.

facts.fact: The page says the vendor's door hanger delivery targets as close to 100% correct delivery as possible rather than 80%, 90%, or 95%.
facts.quote: You don’t want 80%, 90%, or even 95% delivery. You want as close to 100% correct delivery as possible.

facts.fact: Power Direct uses sustainable printing practices including recycled paper and vegetable-based inks, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: Power Direct uses[sustainable printing practices](https://powerdirect.net/sustainability/), including the use of recycled paper and vegetable-based inks.

facts.fact: Door hanger tracking methods listed on the page include unique coupon codes, trackable QR codes, unique landing pages, unique opt-in form pages, and trackable phone numbers.
facts.quote: Unique coupon codes Trackable QR codes Unique landing pages Unique opt-in form pages Trackable phone numbers

facts.fact: The page does not state a price or minimum budget for door hanger campaigns; a quote including budget is offered on request.
facts.quote: Reach out for a sample campaign that includes budget, advanced targeting data (yours to keep), ideas for ad creative, and more.
